'''Highlander''' is a constructed Star Wars CCG format in which a deck may hold only one copy of each card title or persona. [[Decipher]] ran it as a non-sanctioned side event at [[DecipherCon 2000]].<ref name="dcon-sw-events">[http://www.decipher.com/deciphercon/2000/events/starwarsccg.html Star Wars Customizable Card Game events], DecipherCon 2000, Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20010126213800/http://www.decipher.com/deciphercon/2000/events/starwarsccg.html Internet Archive].</ref>

* '''Type:''' constructed
* '''Defined by:''' Decipher (2000)
* '''Card pool:''' the normal constructed pool, one copy of each card title or persona
* '''In use:''' 2000 (DecipherCon 2000)
* '''Also called:''' Highlander Constructed (Decipher's schedule)<ref name="dcon00-sched">[http://www2.decipher.com/tournaments/deciphercon2000/swccgevents.pdf DecipherCon Master Tournament Schedule for Decipher Games], DecipherCon 2000, Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20030413152501/http://www2.decipher.com/tournaments/deciphercon2000/swccgevents.pdf Internet Archive].</ref>
* '''GEMP:''' none

== Card pool ==
Decipher's event page gave one rule: "As the saying goes 'There Can Be Only One'. So your deck can only have one copy of a card title or persona, i.e. only one copy of Darth Vader (Premiere) or Darth Vader, Dark Lord of the Sith (Special Edition), not one of each."<ref name="dcon-sw-events" /> A deck with [[Darth Vader]] therefore may not also hold [[Darth Vader, Dark Lord Of The Sith]], because both are the same persona.

The page names no other change to deck building and no set restriction.<ref name="dcon-sw-events" />

== History ==
Decipher scheduled one Star Wars Highlander event at DecipherCon 2000: Friday 6 October 2000 at 7 p.m. (event #SW124), four games, non-sanctioned.<ref name="dcon-sw-events" /><ref name="dcon00-sched" /> The same convention also scheduled Highlander constructed events for ''Star Trek'' CCG and Young Jedi.<ref name="dcon00-sched" />

At [[DecipherCon 2002]] Decipher's event-formats page described Highlander for ''The Lord of the Rings'' TCG and ''Star Trek'' CCG as "Your deck may contain no more than one of any card title."<ref name="dc02-formats">[http://www1.decipher.com/deciphercon/2002/events/eventformats.html Event Formats], DecipherCon 2002, Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20021017051130/http://www1.decipher.com/deciphercon/2002/events/eventformats.html Internet Archive].</ref> The Star Wars schedule for that convention listed a Highlander constructed event on 1 November 2002 (SW202) without a description.<ref name="dc02-sched">[http://decipher.com/deciphercon/2002/events/eventschedule-otherccg.html Event Schedules], DecipherCon 2002, Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20021023190505/http://decipher.com/deciphercon/2002/events/eventschedule-otherccg.html Internet Archive].</ref>
